about: TamagotchiCore's InteractionScheduler driven directly (mochi_world's must match). For step i of count: now = start + i·step, day = 20000 + floor(i·step / dayEvery); the segment is the last with from ≤ i; at a segment's first step apply postpone(now, by) then noteTriggered(id, now); idleSeconds = now − (start + from·step) + idleOffset. Each step asks nextInteraction(now, day, context) and, only when that gives nothing, nextSolo(now, context), as CompanionWorld does. events lists every non-empty answer [step, kind, value, variant]; checkpoints the scheduler state after a step.

cases.note: idle days with work, busy, waiting, absent and asleep stretches
